summary: Completed backend+frontend regression for Agent Studio, auth replay, authority-gated publish paths, and object-storage upload/image retrieval. Added new automated backend suite and executed desktop/mobile UI validation at exact required viewports.

integration_issues.flow: Agent publish modal (connected non-authority wallet state)
integration_issues.issue: Anonymous authority gate and connect-wallet CTA were validated, but connected non-authority blocked-state was not fully executed in browser automation because no active extension wallet session was available in this run.
Observed browser console CORS failure against DexScreener event endpoint (third-party request). Core hub rendering and tab flows still worked.

action_items: Run one manual/injected-wallet UI pass to verify connected non-authority publish remains blocked after wallet connection.
Optionally suppress or isolate third-party DexScreener console CORS noise if cleaner monitoring is required.
Add explicit data-testid to Explore sort control trigger for stronger E2E selector stability (testability improvement).
critical_code_review_comments: Launch source regression check passed: /app/frontend/src/pages/Launch.jsx is identical to /tmp/mart-source/frontend/src/pages/Launch.jsx (diff exit 0).
Agent backend schema validation is strict and fail-closed as expected (invalid model/capabilities/allocation/risk/creativity/extra fields rejected).
Isolated publish test confirms activity history cap at 30 and authority failure path performs no DB update.
Object storage migration behavior validated: /api/uploads creates Mongo metadata with storage_path and no binary image data field required for retrieval path.
Project testability gap: not every interactive control has a stable data-testid (e.g., Explore sort trigger), which weakens deterministic UI automation.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all planned anonymous/core flows passed; connected non-authority wallet-state pending)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seeded data created. Used ephemeral Ed25519 signing wallets for real off-chain auth tests and cleaned uploaded image metadata test record.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and mobile screenshots were captured at exact 1920x800 and 390x844 for agent overview/config/model modal/long text plus home/launch/hub; no horizontal overflow detected in tested pages. Agent local draft save->reload persistence, per-token isolation, reset cancel/confirm, model picker provider filters (all 6), no-results search, and publish anonymous gate were verified. Backend coverage added for /api/agent/models, /api/agent/validate, /api/tokens/{mint}/agent, authority-gated publish (runtime + isolated), auth replay, and /api/uploads->/api/images object storage metadata flow.
rca of the issue: Primary remaining gap is environment-driven: wallet-extension-dependent connected non-authority state could not be fully asserted in this run without an active browser wallet session. All backend authority gates were validated via API and isolated publish function tests; therefore risk is limited to final UI state confirmation rather than backend enforcement.
